fact: As of the August 2021 mission, CAR had two mobile money offers in service, Orange Money (Ecobank, launched April 2016) and Pata Biani (BPMC with Telecel, August 2019), with about 150,000 accounts open and 65,000 active.
title: République Centrafricaine: Evaluation de l'Ecosystème des Paiements Numériques pour les Programmes de Transferts Monétaires des Filets de Protection Sociale
